project-board.label: Project
project-board.description: A project and its images in a strip: create it on the page, or reuse an existing project.

featured-project.label: Featured project (legacy)
featured-project.description: Legacy block, replaced by blocks stacked one under the other (Title linked to a project, Project…).

video-single.label: Video
video-single.description: A video from your media library: player, or silent loop.

grid.label: Grid
grid.description: Images, videos or texts arranged in columns, from a template or an empty grid.

image.label: Image
image.description: A single image, with an optional caption.

free-board.label: Free board
free-board.description: Cut-out images (PNGs without a background) or videos placed wherever you like, at the size and angle you want, directly on the card.

cv.label: CV
cv.description: Your CV: its pages as images, readable and zoomable, and a button to download the PDF.

section-title.label: Title
section-title.description: A title, with an optional label, introduction and counters; can be the main title of the page; can reuse a project's name and introduction.

hero.label: Opening
hero.description: The big welcome banner: your name, your profession and a tagline, in the form chosen by the theme.
hero.single: There is already an Opening on this page: a page can only have one.

collection-tiles.label: Collection entries
collection-tiles.description: One large image per collection (Characters, Backgrounds…), leading to its page.

collection-intro.label: Collection header (legacy)
collection-intro.description: Legacy block, replaced by a main “Title” with introduction and counters, and the “This page is the collection” setting.

rich-text.label: Text
rich-text.description: A paragraph of text; a title can be added on hover on the page.

contact.label: Contact
contact.description: An invitation to write to you: a button to your email address, or a form (messages arrive in Admin → Messages).

contact-form.label: Contact form (legacy)
contact-form.description: Legacy block, replaced by “Contact” with the form option.

page-link.label: Link to a page
page-link.description: A “Text →” link to a page of the site, between two blocks.

exit.label: Exit
exit.description: The title, message and button that bring the visitor back to the site; with several messages, one is picked at random on each visit.
exit.locked: This block cannot be deleted: it is what brings the visitor back to the site. You can move it and style it.
exit.single: There is already an Exit block on this page: a page can only have one.

random-work.label: A random work
random-work.description: A published work picked at random on each visit, with its image, its title and a link to its page.

profile.label: Profile
profile.description: Your portrait, your introduction, your contact details and your social networks.

collection-projects.label: Projects of a collection (legacy)
collection-projects.description: Legacy block, replaced by “Project” blocks placed one by one.

video.label: Videos (legacy)
video.description: Legacy showcase, replaced by “Video” blocks in a “Grid”.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: A before/after slider, a step-by-step making-of (sketches, values, color, final) or a turnaround to spin through.

grid-videos.label: Video grid
grid-videos.description: One large video and two small ones below (the layout can be changed afterwards).

grid-images.label: Image grid
grid-images.description: Three images side by side (the layout can be changed afterwards).

contact-with-form.label: Contact with form
contact-with-form.description: A form to write to you: fields of your choice, confirmation message.

publish.projectName: Name this project, or pick an existing one.
publish.morePage: Pick the page for the “see more” link.
publish.video: Pick a video (drop it in, or take one from the media library).
publish.image: Pick an image (drop it in, or take one from the media library).
publish.freeBoard: Add at least one image to the free board (drag it onto the area, or use “+ Image”).
publish.cv: Pick the PDF of your CV (drop it on the block, or take it from the media library).
publish.titleProject: Pick the project reused by this title.
publish.contactNoId: This form has no identifier: turn the form option off and on again.
publish.formNoId: This form has no identifier: delete it and add it again.
publish.pageLink: Pick the destination page of this link.
publish.randomCategory: Pick the category the work is drawn from.
publish.randomWorks: Pick at least one work in the selection.
